arxiv-2106-11659.title: USTC-ICTS/PCFT-21-20 Flavor mixing and CP violation from the interplay of S 4 S_{4} modular group and gCP
arxiv-2106-11659.creator: Bu-Yao Qu, Xiang-Gan Liu, Ping-Tao Chen, Gui-Jun Ding Interdisciplinary Center for Theoretical Study and Department of Modern Physics, University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei, Anhui 230026, China
arxiv-2106-11659.description: Abstract We have performed a systematical analysis of lepton and quark masses models based on Γ 4 ≅ S 4 \Gamma_{4}\cong S_{4} modular symmetry with gCP symmetry. We have considered both cases that neutrinos are Majorana particles and Dirac particles.

arxiv-2109-12132.title: Detecting Biosignatures in the Atmospheres of Gas Dwarf Planets with the James Webb Space Telescope Journal: ApJ Facilities: Exoplanet Archive Pandexo ( Batalha et al. 2017 ) , petitRADTRANS ( Mollière et al. 2019 )
arxiv-2109-12132.creator: Caprice L. Phillips, Ji Wang (王吉), Sarah Kendrew, Thomas P. Greene, Renyu Hu, Jeff Valenti, Wendy R. Panero, Joe Schulze
arxiv-2109-12132.description: Abstract Exoplanets with radii between those of Earth and Neptune have stronger surface gravity than Earth, and can retain a sizable hydrogen-dominated atmosphere. In contrast to gas giant planets, we call these planets gas dwarf planets. The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) will offer unprecedented insight into these planets.

arxiv-2209-02992.title: Support τ \tau -tilting modules and semibricks over group graded algebras
arxiv-2209-02992.creator: Simion Breaz, Andrei Marcus, George Ciprian Modoi
arxiv-2209-02992.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Simion Breaz, Andrei Marcus, George Ciprian Modoi. We consider a finite dimensional strongly G G -graded algebra A A with self-injective 1 1 -component B B , and in our main result we prove that the induction from B B to A A of a basic support τ \tau -tilting pair of B B -modules is a support τ \tau -tilting pair ( M , P ) (M,P) of A A -modules if and only if M M is G G -invariant.

arxiv-2303-13485.title: Timely Multi-Process Estimation Over Erasure Channels With and Without Feedback: Signal-Independent Policies Thanks: This work was supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation under Grants CNS 21-14537 and ECCS 21-46099.
arxiv-2303-13485.creator: Karim Banawan, Ahmed Arafa, Karim G. Seddik
arxiv-2303-13485.description: Abstract We consider a multi-process remote estimation system observing K K independent Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes. In this system, a shared sensor samples the K K processes in such a way that the long-term average sum mean square error (MSE) is minimized using signal-independent sampling policies, in which sampling instances are chosen independently from the processes’ values.

arxiv-2304-13103.title: HyMo: Vulnerability Detection in Smart Contracts using a Novel Multi-Modal Hybrid Model
arxiv-2304-13103.creator: Mohammad Khodadadi, Jafar Tahmoresnezhad
arxiv-2304-13103.description: Abstract With blockchain technology rapidly progress, the smart contracts have become a common tool in a number of industries including finance, healthcare, insurance and gaming. The number of smart contracts has multiplied, and at the same time, the security of smart contracts has drawn considerable attention due to the monetary losses brought on by smart contract vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2403-10876.title: Kodaira vanishing theorems for Kähler Lie algebroids
arxiv-2403-10876.creator: Tengzhou Hu
arxiv-2403-10876.description: Abstract A Lie algebroid is a generalization of Lie algebra that provides a general framework to describe the symmetries of a manifold. In this paper, we generalize the Kodaira vanishing theorem, which is a basic result in complex geometry, to Kähler Lie algebroids.

arxiv-2502-15758.title: Maturity Framework for Enhancing Machine Learning Quality
arxiv-2502-15758.creator: Angelantonio Castelli, Georgios Christos Chouliaras, Dmitri Goldenberg
arxiv-2502-15758.description: Abstract . With the rapid integration of Machine Learning (ML) in business applications and processes, it is crucial to ensure the quality, reliability and reproducibility of such systems. We suggest a methodical approach towards ML system quality assessment and introduce a structured Maturity framework for governance of ML.

arxiv-2602-09684.title: The S-wave topped meson
arxiv-2602-09684.creator: Jun-Hao Zhang 1,2, Shuo Yang 1,2, Bing-Dong Wan 1,2
arxiv-2602-09684.description: Abstract Inspired by the recent observation of the near-threshold enhancement in top-quark pair production by CMS and ATLAS, we investigate the mass spectrum of S-wave topped meson which containing a single top quark, i.e., t ​ q ¯ t\bar{q} , t ​ c ¯ t\bar{c} , and t ​ b ¯ t\bar{b} , in the framework of Bethe-Salpeter formalism.

arxiv-2602-23947.title: Hierarchical Concept-based Interpretable Models
arxiv-2602-23947.creator: Oscar Hill, Mateo Espinosa Zarlenga, Mateja Jamnik
arxiv-2602-23947.description: Abstract Modern deep neural networks remain challenging to interpret due to the opacity of their latent representations, impeding model understanding, debugging, and debiasing. Concept Embedding Models (CEMs) address this by mapping inputs to human-interpretable concept representations from which tasks can be predicted.

pmc-10613447.title: Associations Between the Suicidal Ideation and the Tolerance for Psychological Pain and Tolerance for Physical Pain in Patients Diagnosed with Major Depressive Disorder
pmc-10613447.creator: Caner Yeşiloğlu, Lut Tamam, Mehmet Emin Demirkol, Zeynep Namlı, Mahmut Onur Karaytuğ
pmc-10613447.description: PurposePatients with major depressive disorder (MDD) may experience more frequent and severe psychological and physical pain complaints compared to those without depression. As the tolerance to psychological pain decreases in patients with MDD, the severity of suicidal ideation tends to increase. Furthermore, the tolerance for physical pain (TPP) has been related with suicidal behavior.

pmc-12678961.description: BACKGROUNDClaudin-6 (CLDN6), a tight junction protein typically restricted to embryonic tissues, is re-expressed in various cancers. pmc-13386647.creator: Abdul Baten, Raaj Kishore Biswas, Evie Kendal, Jahar Bhowmik
pmc-13386647.description: BackgroundBangladesh, like many low- and middle-income countries, is lagging behind the Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) target related to reducing maternal mortality by 2030. Maternal healthcare services (MHS) utilization remains low and inequitable, contributing to poor maternal outcomes. This study analyzed trends, determinants, and inequalities in MHS utilization in Bangladesh from 2004 to 2022.
